title: Collapse Execute and Writes
notes: Execute and Write tool stacks collapse like Reads. Tap to expand; they stay open while running.

title: Half-screen @ file picker
notes: The @ file list is a half-screen scrollable popup like / and history. It no longer fills the screen or opens the keyboard.

title: PC queue on the phone
notes: The session queue on the PC shows on the phone with Start and Cancel. App-queued follow-ups appear in the same list.

title: Cleaner notification icon
notes: Status-bar and notification mark is a simple Grok C with slash. Remote arcs are gone so it reads at small size.

title: Notify on PC UAC prompt
notes: The phone gets a notification when Windows shows a UAC administrator prompt on this PC.

title: Outside-tap menus, clock and paperclip
notes: / @ and history menus close when you tap outside. History is a clock; attach is a paperclip.

title: Send no longer waits on the whole turn
notes: The phone gets an immediate OK when a message is handed to Grok. The reply still streams live. Failed to fetch no longer kicks off a stuck Connecting state if the PC is still reachable.

title: Line mic icon, chat name in header
notes: Mic is a B&W silhouette matching the other tools. In a session the header shows the chat name with connection status underneath.

title: Send via gateway, no load hang
notes: Session history loads from disk without waiting on ACP. Sends go through the PC gateway. Grok agent now uses GROK_HOME so it sees the signed-in TUI. Opening a session no longer hangs on Writing after ws closed.

title: Skip broken ACP login
notes: Phone no longer calls authenticate with cached_token when Grok only offers grok.com and the PC TUI is already signed in. That was Authentication cancelled / Authentication required.

title: Fix Authentication cancelled
notes: Stop the background sidecar from fighting the phone login. Authenticate retries instead of failing on the first cancel.

title: Show hidden, pass-complete notify
notes: Show hidden is a full-width button on the session list. Pass-complete notifications fire when a chat finishes, including from disk activity if you are not looking at that session.

title: Swipe to hide, star in the row
notes: Hide is a swipe-left action on a session. The star sits on the right inside the card, not as a separate button.

title: Pull to refresh, no plan prompt on history
notes: Pull down on the session list to refresh and reconnect. Opening a session no longer pops plan approval from old history; that sheet only appears after a new request, or if you tap Plan.

title: Pin, hide, splash versions
notes: Star/pin sessions to the top and hide others from the list (Show hidden to bring them back). Connect splash shows App version and the Grok Build version on this PC.

title: Fewer, clearer notifications
notes: Alerts only for approval needed, a real problem, or pass complete, with session context. Status-bar icon is a thicker Grok Remote mark. No ping while you are already looking at that session.

title: Fix garbled composer icons
notes: UTF-8 icons and punctuation were corrupted by the last publish. Mic, plus, arrows, and ellipsis are restored.

title: Plan green, Auto default
notes: Plan is green; Auto is grey/system and the default. Ask blue, Approve red.

title: Bigger prompt, mode colors
notes: Composer tools sit on their own row so the message box is full width.
Prompt border and text follow mode: Ask blue, Plan magenta, Auto amber, Approve red — toggles under the box.

title: Working Android mic
notes: 🎤 opens the phone’s speech-to-text dialog (asks for microphone permission) and pastes into the prompt without sending.

title: Phone is a plan-approval client
notes: The app no longer authenticates as headless, so Grok can send plan approval to the phone.
Approve answers x.ai/exit_plan_mode (approved / rejected / abandoned) instead of leaving the RPC unanswered.

title: Plan Approve does not hang
notes: Approve closes the plan sheet immediately and answers the permission. It no longer waits on /plan, which deadlocked with Grok still waiting for approval.

title: Grok Remote notification icon
notes: Needs-you, turn-complete, and the keep-alive notice use the Grok Remote logo instead of a generic Android icon.

title: Voice, camera, find
notes: Mic on the composer dictates into the box and does not send.
＋ offers Take photo or Photo library (clipboard paste still works).
⌕ finds text in the thread; ↑ ↓ jumps between hits.

title: Phone Approve and /plan actually work
notes: Slash commands like /plan are no longer rewritten to [Grok Remote] /plan.
Approve sends /plan and waits until plan mode ends instead of only closing the overlay.

title: Plan approval on the phone
notes: exit_plan_mode opens a scrollable plan preview instead of silently exiting.
Approve, Request changes, or Quit — same idea as the PC TUI.
Tap the Plan chip to reopen the current plan.md.

title: Scrollable changelog
notes: Settings and the changelog list scroll with your finger instead of getting cut off.

title: Don't yank the thread while thinking
notes: Scrolling up while Grok is working no longer snaps you back to the bottom.
A ↓ button appears when you're not at the latest; tap it to jump down.

title: @ search, last session, copy
notes: @ file picker has search; typing @name in the prompt suggests files.
The app reopens the last session you were in.
Copy on each Grok reply copies the markdown.

title: @ files, notify actions, biometrics
notes: @ opens a file browser for the session folder and inserts @path into the prompt.
Needs-you notifications include Open and Allow.
Fingerprint / face unlock when a PIN is set (installed APK).

title: PIN, blocking permissions, LAN notify
notes: Optional 4–8 digit PIN locks the app when you leave it.
Permission prompts block the composer until you choose Allow or Reject.
Needs-you and turn-complete fire local notifications; tapping opens the session.
A quiet foreground notification keeps the LAN socket alive in the background.

title: Usage, todos, slash, roster edit
notes: Usage chip shows context percent; tap for model, tokens, turns.
Todos chip lists the current plan (tap a group to expand).
/ compact, rewind, and fork run from the slash palette (with confirm).
Long-press a session to rename or delete (live PC sessions stay protected).

title: Mode chips, grouped tools, queue, images
notes: Ask / Plan / Auto / Approve, model, and effort chips apply to the live PC session.
Consecutive reads/searches/edits collapse to “Read 9 files” (tap to expand).
Send while Grok is working queues a follow-up; Send now interrupts like the TUI.
＋ attaches a photo; paste from clipboard also works.

title: Chat stays put when you swipe
notes: Swiping left or right on the thread no longer slides the whole chat.
Long tool lines and paths wrap instead of making a phantom page to the right.

title: Reply formatting matches Grok Build
notes: Grok replies render as markdown (bold, lists, links) instead of mashed raw text.
Each reply shows the time and Worked for duration, like the PC card.
Streaming no longer drops spaces and punctuation.

title: Thinking, status timer, command history
notes: Thinking stays expanded with Grok Build formatting (Thought for Xs, paragraph text).
Live spinner shows Waiting / Thinking / Writing / edit (and the current tool) with a timer, plus Stop.
Tools stay one-line — no file contents or code scrolling in the thread.
↑ command history lists PC and App prompts; tapping pastes into the box without sending.

title: Live thread + waiting
notes: PC typing and Grok turns stream into the open thread — no close/reopen.
Send shows Waiting / Thinking immediately so you can tell it went through.
Thinking stays open as it streams, like Grok Build.

title: In-app sessions, full history, working back
notes: APK no longer jumps to the phone browser after Connect — UI stays in the app.
Opening a session loads the full Grok Build thread (user, Grok, tools, thoughts) from disk, then attaches live.
Android back and the in-app back button return to the session list instead of leaving the app.

title: Send, scroll, icon, honest updates
notes: Sending a message reattaches the session if the socket dropped instead of doing nothing.
Keepalive every 20s and auto-reconnect without tapping Reconnect.
Update banner only if the APK version is actually older (0.1.1 no longer nagged itself).
Thread view locks height and jumps to the latest message like Grok.
App icon: Grok slash with remote signal flair.

title: APK uses the real LAN page
notes: Android WebView no longer iframes the UI (that blocked WebSockets).
App navigates to the LAN gateway like the working PC browser.
Cleartext HTTP scheme so LAN fetch is not mixed-content.
Connect screen probes the LAN first and shows scan errors.

title: First LAN remote client
notes: Session roster from live Grok Build ACP (session/list).
Open a session, replay history, send prompts, stream replies and tool cards.
Permission prompts, cancel turn, and new session from the phone.
LAN-only gateway on port 2420; Grok ACP on 2419.
In-app APK update banner with changelog and download from this server.
Local notifications when a session needs you (while the app is connected).
